ASSIGNING EMERGENCY PREPAREDNESS FUNCTIONS TO THE  
SECRETARY OF HEALTH, EDUCATION, AND WELFARE
By virtue o f the authority vested in me as President o f the United 
States, including authority vested in me by Reorganization Plan No. 1 
o f 1958, it is hereby ordered as follows:

emergency plans and develop preparedness programs covering health

and educational programs as defined below. These plans and pro­
grams shall be designed to develop a state o f readiness in these areas 
with respect to all conditions of national emergency including attack 
upon the United States.
